context: Tests whether the agent follows the implement phase protocol: status updates before/after, progress log, commit format, and correct sequencing

checklist.name: reads-progress-log-first
checklist.description: Agent mentions reading the progress log for context from prior tasks BEFORE starting work

checklist.name: reads-task-goal-and-boundary
checklist.description: Agent mentions reading the task's goal, boundary, and done-when criteria before building

checklist.name: updates-status-to-in-progress
checklist.description: Agent explicitly states updating task 2 status to 'In Progress' before doing the work

checklist.name: updates-status-to-done
checklist.description: Agent explicitly states updating task 2 status to 'Done' after completing the work

checklist.name: adds-progress-log-entry
checklist.description: Agent mentions adding a progress log entry with date and summary after completing the task

checklist.name: commit-references-spec-and-task
checklist.description: Agent shows a commit message that references the spec number and task number (e.g. 'Part of specs/0002-notifications task 2')

checklist.name: verifies-done-when
checklist.description: Agent mentions running tests or verifying against the done-when criteria before marking Done

checklist.name: correct-sequence
checklist.description: The sequence is: read context → set In Progress → build → verify → set Done → log → commit (not jumbled)
